title: Monthly Safety Board and Equipment Inspection

footer.manualLine: Visual Aid and Electrical System Maintenance Manual.

items.text: Safety board is mounted and accessible in or adjacent to the lighting vault
Rubber insulating gloves — present, tested, and within certification date
Grounding cables — present and in serviceable condition
Safety goggles — present and in serviceable condition
Face shield — present and in serviceable condition
Fire extinguisher (Class C or ABC) present, fully charged, within inspection date
First aid kit — fully stocked and within all expiry dates
VOM / DMM — calibration date verified and current (record date: ______)
Megohmmeter — calibration date verified and current (record date: ______)
True-RMS clamp-on ammeter — calibration date verified and current (record date: ______)
Infrared thermometer — calibration date verified and current
Ground rod resistance tester — calibration date verified and current
Photometer — calibration date verified and current (if available)
All calibration certificates filed in the Technical Library
No expired or damaged test equipment in active service
LOTO kit — all padlocks, tags, and hasps present and functional
Gas monitor for confined space entry — operational, batteries charged, calibration current

validationRules: Every item marked NOSAT requires non-empty remarks before submission.
notes: Item codes C01-01.. are SYNTHETIC. The approved form lists items without identifiers; codes exist only so responses, incidents and audit records can reference a row, and must never be printed on the exported form.
Generated by scripts/vaes-extract.mjs from the approved base PDF. Re-run it rather than hand-editing; every coordinate is a measured glyph position.
Document control values are pre-printed constants on the approved form — not inputs, and never overlaid.
